description: Read Aha! product plans, features and ideas and manage notes.

aha_new_epic_trigger.description: Runs for each new epic in Aha!. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, reference_num, url, created_at, updated_at
